titulo_video: I BOUGHT CLOTHES FOR HER AND LOOK WHAT HAPPENED IN CHAPTER 11 OF THE INHERITOR

locucoes.text: Picture this, the day's ending in the city and our boy Joo Inhyuk's caught up in a pretty unusual situation.
AH, LIKE...
So they stop in front of the lit-up facade of a photo booth, right in the middle of their outing.
A stranger lets out a pained lament right at the entrance, signaling something's very wrong before they even feel the tension in the air.
Then they go into the place full of booths and decorations, but the vibe starts getting heavy.
Man oh man, the tension rises instantly between the two in that corner.
WHAT?
IT'S JUST..
SOMETHING LIKE...
OKAY...
So the girl hugs herself with her back turned, looking pretty embarrassed about the situation.
Then the sign appears showing the release website, but we're already back to the story.
The outside sign shows thirty minutes earlier, revealing the mess started way before.
ARF..
And the dude's walking all sweaty and tense through the crowd, running from who knows what.
Until he looks to the side with that face of someone who owes and won't pay.
THAT WAS CLOSE..
But suddenly the girl looks at herself in the mirror with her face all flushed, damn.
She freezes before her reflection, processing her own reaction as her heart races, setting the stage for this unexpected approach coming right up.
Then she gets closer asking everything with a really gentle smile.
I LIKED IT BECAUSE OF THAT.
So the camera focuses right on the young woman's legs as she takes a step.
AND VERY BEAUTIFUL.
For the love of god, she breaks into a huge smile showing a joy that's contagious.
But our boy's got his face red as a tomato, holding a bag.
PHEW... YES... WHAT A RELIEF.
LET ME SEE... SHOES, SOCKS, PAJAMAS.. AND..
PANTIES AND BRA...
YOU CHOSE THIS FOR ME?
IF YOU WEAR IT..
Man, the guy freezes with his eyes wide open not knowing where to hide his face.
THIS...
The lament cuts through the tense moment, revealing the situation spiraling out of control as she holds a gaze loaded with ulterior motives.
And the girl looks with that face of desire that leaves anyone breathless.
Master~♥
BAGS!
The view from the sky shows the pink clouds as the sun goes away.
In the end, they split the weight and walk together down the sidewalk.
? WHAT?
FOR THE CLOTHES. I SHOULD'VE BEEN PREPARED, BUT...
So the two of them stay in absolute silence walking side by side.
THINKING ABOUT IT... YOU NEVER HAD CLOTHES?
NO! NO!
Night falls and the house facade appears under the moonlight.
BUT... YOU COULDN'T
Have brought it? It's just...
The password...
To the house..
What was it..?
So the couple keeps walking down the street carrying the shopping bags.
The close-up focuses on her face with the man right below looking confused.
The twilight atmosphere is broken out of nowhere by Sarafim's laughter.
PUAH! HAHAHA
The shock is immediate when the laughter stops abruptly, making it clear something unusual happened to completely freeze their interaction.
WHY ARE YOU LAUGHING?
SOMETIMES I CAN'T KEEP MY COMPOSURE..
HOW FUNNY.
Our boy gets all embarrassed by her reaction, not knowing what to do.
SO. WANNA GO IN THERE?
Then he opens that gentle smile and points to the establishment right behind.
The studio logo shines on the screen along with the QR code.
And the two pose side by side smiling nicely for the camera.
They pose with their fingers in a V while the clicks keep happening.
Then they turn their backs and throw up that thumbs up for the result.
Until the voice from outside warns that the photos are ready.
A hand holds the strip of photos with the pictures of the two together.
So the guy looks down with an expression of pure concern.
IT WASN'T A LIE;
The girl gets all red looking at his back in there.
She loses her patience and decides to confront his silence, waiting for a definitive answer that finally puts the cards on the table now.
WELL...
The intimate atmosphere is interrupted by a scare, when the abrupt movement of the curtain exposes what should've been hidden from everyone.
But suddenly someone yanks the curtain hard to the side.
And pieces of clothing start flying everywhere in total chaos.
HUH?!
Man oh man, the dude catches the girl by surprise in the middle of the scene.
Why.. Did you take off my clothes...?
Didn't you like it?
Why? Why did you do this?
Now, this is better for you.
A giant question mark floats alone on the screen.
THIS WAY YOU'LL BE NATURAL.
STARTING TO TAKE THE PHOTOS. !!
AH, WAIT.. ONE- TWO-
Then that giant onomatopoeia appears bursting the entire panel.
And the heat rises for real between the two in the booth.
So he gets closer and she gives that startled reaction.
SO..
KYAH!
Damn, things get intense right at the moment of the flash.
Will this disguise work out or is the problem that someone's gonna see everything? F for our boy!
